scenario: A county public-defender office uses an agent pipeline to triage newly assigned cases by likely legal complexity and needed attorney hours, so more-complex cases are routed to senior attorneys with more-protective motions practice. The pipeline extracts case intake narratives and charging documents, computes a case-complexity score and attorney-assignment tier, and produces a triage memo.
info_flow: nlp-toolkit analyzes the defendant intake narrative and produces linguistic metrics (perplexity, burstiness, vocabulary richness) → sentiment-priority-scorer ingests those metrics alongside charge metadata to compute a priority score and tier (P1/P2/P3) → legaldoc-ai summarizes the charging document and incorporates the tier into the final triage memo that assigns attorney hours and seniority level.
